sponsored.t: Relates to penalties for a lodging facility that fails to comply with certain requirements for providing information concerning services for human trafficking victims
sponsored.sum: Provides that a lodging facility that fails to comply with certain requirements for providing information concerning services for human trafficking victims shall be liable for a civil penalty of five hundred dollars for a first offense and one thousand dollars for each subsequent offense; provides for concurrent enforcement by the director or commissioner of a municipal consumer affairs office or by the town attorney, city corporation counsel, or other lawful designee of a municipality.

sponsored.t: Prohibits operators of a website, application, software, program, or service from allowing users to nudify a still or video image
sponsored.sum: Prohibits operators of a website, application, software, program, or service from allowing users to nudify a still or video image; prohibits advertising or promoting websites, applications, software, programs, or services that allow users to nudify a still or video image; provides an exception when technical skill is required to nudify an image; establishes penalties for violations of such provisions; establishes the nudification prohibition recoveries services fund to provide grants to support the direct needs of victims of sexual assault, domestic violence, and child abuse.

sponsored.t: Relates to adjudications and owner liability for a violation of traffic-control signal indications in the village of Pelham Manor
sponsored.sum: Extends provisions of law permitting adjudications and owner liability for a violation of traffic-control signal indications in the village of Pelham Manor.

sponsored.t: Establishes a school speed zone camera demonstration program in the village of Pelham
sponsored.sum: Establishes a school speed zone camera demonstration program in the village of Pelham; repeals authorization of program December 31, 2031.

sponsored.t: Relates to coverage for the treatment of ameloblastoma
sponsored.sum: Relates to medical and dental coverage for the treatment of ameloblastoma which shall include but is not limited to dental implants and implant-related services.

sponsored.t: Authorizes camp operators and employees to administer medications and treatment to children under certain circumstances
sponsored.sum: Allows camp employees who are 18 years of age or older to administer medications and treatment to children, under parent or guardian consent and authorization, pursuant to a patient specific order and in compliance with regulations.

sponsored.t: Makes conforming changes reflecting the previously authorized scope of practice of nurse practitioners
sponsored.sum: Makes conforming changes reflecting the previously authorized scope of practice of nurse practitioners; adds nurse practitioners as persons who can authorize or make certain determinations authorized to be made or determined by physicians.

sponsored.t: Increases the time frame for payments of certain expenses by adoptive parents
sponsored.sum: Increases the time frame for payments of certain expenses by adoptive parents to 180 days prior to birth and 45 days after birth.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "victims protection and child sex buyer accountability act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "victims protection and child sex buyer accountability act" relating to increasing the age of victims of the patronizing, promoting, and compelling of prostitution.

sponsored.t: Relates to sexual offense evidence collection kit procedures
sponsored.sum: Requires that all sexual offense evidence shall be kept in a locked, separate and secure area for twenty years from the date of collection or until the victim's fortieth birthday, whichever is later; makes other sexual offense evidence collection kit procedures.

sponsored.t: Relates to contracts between state agencies and not-for-profit organizations
sponsored.sum: Relates to provisions governing contracting between state agencies and not-for-profit organizations including new, renewal, and extension contracts.

sponsored.t: Relates to requirements associated with contracts between state agencies and not-for-profit organizations
sponsored.sum: Relates to requirements associated with contracts between state agencies and not-for-profit organizations including an advance payment of 25% of the total award to cover expenses incurred in the first quarter.

sponsored.t: Requires policies for the use of automatic license plate reader systems
sponsored.sum: Requires the consumer protection division to promulgate a policy governing the use of automatic license plate reader systems by non-law enforcement agencies and non-government entities; requires such non-law enforcement agencies and non-government entities to conspicuously post such policy on their website or in their place of business.

sponsored.t: Relates to optional disability coverage for county probation officers
sponsored.sum: Provides optional disability coverage for county probation officers.

sponsored.t: Relates to protections against utility termination for medical emergencies, life-support equipment and elderly, blind and disabled customers
sponsored.sum: Establishes uniform definitions, standardized procedures, and uniform applications or forms, for determining a medical emergency, life-support equipment and designation of elderly, blind and disabled customers protected from termination of utility services.

sponsored.t: Relates to information that residential health care facilities are required to disclose to residents and their families
sponsored.sum: Relates to information that residential health care facilities are required to separately disclose to residents and their families; requires such information to be posted on the residential health care facility's website.

sponsored.t: Establishes a demonstration program for pediatric palliative care centers
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "pediatric palliative care center act" to establish a demonstration program for pediatric palliative care centers for up to five not-for-profits to provide palliative care to individuals who are under twenty-one years of age, have been diagnosed with a chronic, complex, life-threatening illness that is expected to shorten their life expectancy, and is not expected to survive past twenty-one years of age; authorizes the establishment or approval of a rate methodology.

sponsored.t: Expands how applicants may qualify for a license to be a dentist
sponsored.sum: Expands how applicants may qualify for a license to be a dentist to include postdoctoral specialty programs and advanced education programs in general dentistry.

sponsored.t: Establishes the cesarean births review board
sponsored.sum: Establishes the cesarean births review board; provides such board shall be comprised of multidisciplinary experts to review the rate of cesarean births at hospitals in the state; provides reporting requirements.

sponsored.t: Relates to the definition of family for purposes of services provided by voluntary foster care agency health facilities
sponsored.sum: Includes both the birth family and the foster family of children in foster care, and other families receiving child welfare services from the authorized agency or the local departments of social services in the case of authorized agencies in the definition of family for purposes of services provided by voluntary foster care agency health facilities.

sponsored.t: Approves notice and proof of disability from an attending nurse practitioner
sponsored.sum: Approves notice and proof of disability or proof of need for family leave, or proof of disability for a special cross-bow permit, from an attending nurse practitioner.

sponsored.t: Requires residential health care facilities to maintain hospice agreements to ensure access to hospice services for eligible residents
sponsored.sum: Requires residential health care facilities to maintain hospice agreements to ensure access to hospice services for eligible residents.

sponsored.t: Requires the council on arts to make recommendations on the renaming of the agency buildings located at the empire state plaza
sponsored.sum: Requires the council on arts to make recommendations on the renaming of the agency buildings located at the empire state plaza; requires the governor to choose the new agency building names within 60 days after the council's recommendation.

sponsored.t: Provides for enrollment in medical assistance programs for incarcerated individuals
sponsored.sum: Provides for enrollment of eligible incarcerated persons in the medical assistance for needy persons program; provides for enrollment of incarcerated individuals in other medical assistance programs, where eligible.

sponsored.t: Relates to posting financial disclosure filings for candidates for statewide elected office or candidate for a member of the legislature
sponsored.sum: Relates to the annual statement of financial disclosure and the posting of financial disclosure filings for candidates for statewide elected office or candidates for a member of the legislature.

sponsored.t: Requires bicycles advertised for sale or resale in New York state to have an identifying serial number and for such serial number to be posted in any advertisement for such bicycle
sponsored.sum: Requires bicycles advertised for sale or resale in New York state to have an identifying serial number in legible boldfaced figures in one of certain specified areas on the bicycle; requires advertisements for bicycles to clearly and conspicuously include a photograph of such bicycles; exempts online marketplaces from placing identifying serial numbers on bicycles.

sponsored.t: Relates to deadlines for filing nominating petitions for small city school board elections
sponsored.sum: Requires that nominating petitions for small city school district elections be submitted no later than thirty days prior to the election; makes technical corrections relating to such small city school board elections.

sponsored.t: Replaces the terms father, mother, and filiation to gender neutral language; repealer
sponsored.sum: Replaces the terms father, mother, and filiation to gender neutral language.

sponsored.t: Relates to adult care facility financial statements
sponsored.sum: Requires statements to be accompanied by a review performed in accordance with a statement on standards for accounting and review services.

sponsored.t: Relates to a nursing facility transition and diversion Medicaid waiting list
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the commissioner of health to establish nursing facility transition and diversion Medicaid waiting lists per designated waiver region, once the federally approved capacity for the waiver is reached.

sponsored.t: Removes the authority of the state civil service commission to administer the county service in Westchester
sponsored.sum: Removes the authority of the state civil service commission to administer the county service in Westchester.

sponsored.t: Relates to local block anesthesia certificate
sponsored.sum: Provides that a dental hygienist shall not administer local block anesthesia without a certificate and except under the personal supervision of a dentist and in conjunction with the performance of dental hygiene procedures authorized by law and in accordance with regulations promulgated by the commissioner.

sponsored.t: Relates to the applicability of open meetings and freedom of information laws to certain not-for-profit corporations
sponsored.sum: Relates to the applicability of open meetings and freedom of information laws to certain not-for-profit corporations.

sponsored.t: Requires the department of health examine heat related deaths in the state of New York
sponsored.sum: Requires the department of health examine heat-related deaths in the state of New York; requires the department to issue a report to the temporary president of the senate, speaker of the assembly and the governor.

sponsored.t: Establishes a waiting period before a firearm, shotgun or rifle may be delivered to a person
sponsored.sum: Establishes a three calendar day waiting period from contact of the New York State National Instant Background Check System (NYS NICS) before a firearm, shotgun or rifle may be delivered to a person; provides exceptions where a person possesses a license to purchase, carry or possess a pistol, revolver, or semiautomatic rifle.

sponsored.t: Relates to including dental implants, replacement dental prosthetic appliances, crowns and root canals as medically necessary dental care and services for coverage under the Medicaid program
sponsored.sum: Includes implants, replacement dental prosthetic appliances, crowns and root canals as medically necessary dental care and services for coverage under the Medicaid program if a qualified dentist authorizes the procedures.

sponsored.t: Requires notification of firearm denials to local law enforcement and the local prosecutor having jurisdiction where the prohibited person sought to acquire the firearm
sponsored.sum: Requires notification of firearm denials to local law enforcement and the local prosecutor having jurisdiction where the prohibited person sought to acquire the firearm; requires local law enforcement to initiate a criminal investigation within five business days.

sponsored.t: Establishes extended producer responsibility for mattresses
sponsored.sum: Establishes extended producer responsibility for mattresses.

sponsored.t: Requires the department of health to develop and maternal health care providers to distribute written information about episiotomy to maternity patients
sponsored.sum: Requires the department of health to develop and maternal health care providers to distribute written information about episiotomy to maternity patients.

sponsored.t: Relates to restricting the sale of tobacco products and vapor products; repealer
sponsored.sum: Restricts the sale of tobacco products and vapor products to persons born after December 31, 2007.

sponsored.t: Relates to the compulsory age for full time instruction from six to five years of age and certain exceptions for minor children
sponsored.sum: Relates to the compulsory age for full time instruction from six to five years of age and certain exceptions for minor children; requires kindergarten in certain school districts.

sponsored.t: Enacts the lead pipe replacement act
sponsored.sum: Enacts the lead pipe replacement act to require the replacement of all lead service lines by November 1, 2037.

sponsored.t: Expands the use of body scanners to facilities operated by the office of mental health, the office for people with developmental disabilities and the office of children and family services
sponsored.sum: Expands the use of body scanners to facilities operated by the office of mental health and the office for people with developmental disabilities; establishes alternative methods of screening.

sponsored.t: Directs the department of health to collect certain data from relevant entities regarding calls and dispatches for emergency medical services
sponsored.sum: Directs the department of health to collect certain data from relevant entities, and designated public safety answering points to receive 911 service calls, regarding calls and dispatches for emergency medical services; establishes reporting requirements.

sponsored.t: Clarifies the standard of care for animals held in or being transported by animal shelters; repealer
sponsored.sum: Clarifies the standard of care for animals held in or being transported by animal shelters including the length of time and conditions such animal may be exposed to.

sponsored.t: Requires examination and reporting on cost reports from licensed home care service agencies
sponsored.sum: Requires the Medicaid inspector general to exam and report to the legislature on cost reports from licensed home care service agencies.

sponsored.t: Requires periodic reviews of pending applications for material change in the coverage status of certain matters relative to new health technology assessment or medical evidence
sponsored.sum: Requires periodic reviews of pending applications for material change in the coverage status of certain matters relative to new health technology assessment or medical evidence.

sponsored.t: Requires hospitals to obtain verbal and written informed consent from a patient or representative before including such patient information in a general hospital facility directory
sponsored.sum: Requires hospitals to obtain verbal and written informed consent from a patient or representative before including such patient's information in a general hospital facility directory.

sponsored.t: Relates to developing microgrids in preparation for extreme weather events and other risks to public security
sponsored.sum: Establishes a program to develop microgrids that are capable of providing an uninterrupted supply of power to one or more community outage assets through an extended electric distribution outage.

sponsored.t: Relates to immunization vaccines for children
sponsored.sum: Requires the administration of certain vaccines for children in accordance with regulations issued by the commissioner, utilizing generally accepted medical standards and based on recommendations of the American Academy of Pediatrics, the American Academy of Family Physicians, the American College of Obstetricians and Gynecologists, the American College of Physicians, the Advisory Committee on Immunization Practices, and/or other similar nationally or internationally recognized scientific organizations; removes certain requirements for vaccines to be administered under federal guidance.

sponsored.t: Establishes uniform waiting list priorities for domestic violence survivors applying for public housing
sponsored.sum: Establishes uniform waiting list priorities for domestic violence survivors applying for public housing.

sponsored.t: Relates to expanding the crime of public lewdness
sponsored.sum: Adds to the crime of public lewdness the electronic transmission of an image depicting exposed private or intimate parts without the consent of the recipient.

sponsored.t: Relates to the timeframe for guardianship hearings
sponsored.sum: Increases the timeframe for guardianship hearings to thirty-five days.

sponsored.t: Relates to licensing laser hair removal technicians
sponsored.sum: Relates to licensing laser hair removal technicians; establishes laser hair removal rules, regulations and standards.

sponsored.t: Requires 911 call-takers and dispatchers to complete T-CPR training
sponsored.sum: Requires 911 call-takers and dispatchers to complete telecommunicator CPR training which shall include recognizing signs of cardiac arrest during emergency calls, providing instructions for initiating CPR instructions to callers, coordinating with emergency medical services dispatch, and using automated external defibrillators when available and appropriate.

sponsored.t: Relates to licensure of PACE organizations
sponsored.sum: Relates to requirements for licensure of PACE organizations and to the authority of the commissioner of health to process applications for licensure of PACE organizations when regulations of such commissioner are pending.

sponsored.t: Enacts the medical psilocybin act
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the use of psilocybin to treat qualified medical conditions; prohibits criminal diversion of medical psilocybin.

sponsored.t: Relates to the organization of the Port Authority
sponsored.ls: Port Authority of New York and New Jersey
sponsored.sum: Relates to port authority organization, appearance and notice; establishes the port authority transportation advisory committee.

sponsored.t: Requires the municipal police training council establish standards for the destruction of controlled substances
sponsored.sum: Requires the municipal police training council establish standards for the destruction of controlled substances; requires such destruction of controlled substances policies be publicly available.

sponsored.t: Relates to the authority of certain existing assisted living programs to expand capacity by nine or fewer beds under an expedited process
sponsored.sum: Authorizes certain existing assisted living programs to expand capacity by nine or fewer beds under an expedited process.

sponsored.t: Provides for primary care investment
sponsored.sum: Requires health care plans and payors to have a minimum of twelve and one-half percent of their total expenditures on physical and mental health annually be for primary care services.

sponsored.t: Relates to coercive control
sponsored.sum: Relates to coercive control; provides that the family court and the criminal courts shall have concurrent jurisdiction over acts which constitute coercive control; provides that courts may issue orders of protection upon a finding of coercive control; directs the office of court administration, in consultation with the office for the prevention of domestic violence and certain organizations, to develop and administer training for judges and court clerks on coercive control.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing a voluntary waiver of the right to purchase firearms, rifles or shotguns
sponsored.sum: Relates to establishing a voluntary waiver of the right to purchase firearms, rifles or shotguns; requires the division of state police to maintain statewide records of individuals who have waived the right to purchase firearms, rifles, or shotguns and any revocations of such waivers.

sponsored.t: Relates to automatic license plate readers
sponsored.sum: Relates to automatic license plate readers (ALPRs) and mandatory postings of policies and annual reporting requirements.

sponsored.t: Requires hospitals to report cases of poisoning to the regional poison control center
sponsored.sum: Requires hospitals to report cases of poisoning to the regional poison control center.

sponsored.t: Requires the immunization of certain post-secondary students against hepatitis B
sponsored.sum: Requires the immunization of certain post-secondary students against hepatitis B.

sponsored.t: Relates to the functions of the Medicaid inspector general with respect to audit and review of medical assistance program funds
sponsored.sum: Requires the Medicaid inspector general to comply with standards relating to the audit and review of medical assistance program funds.

sponsored.t: Requires health insurance contracts cover postpartum pelvic floor therapy
sponsored.sum: Requires health insurance contracts cover postpartum pelvic floor physical therapy for new mothers.

sponsored.t: Relates to coverage for New Yorkers losing insurance due to the implementation of HR 1
sponsored.sum: Provides for coverage for New Yorkers losing insurance due to the implementation of HR 1.

sponsored.t: Enacts the oversight of health programs act
sponsored.sum: Enacts the oversight of health programs act to allow for certain members of the legislature to request records related to any vendor contracted with the state to facilitate in the administration or delivery of any publicly subsidized health program.

sponsored.t: Relates to the composition of corn masa flour and wet corn masa product
sponsored.sum: Relates to the composition of corn masa flour and wet corn masa product.

sponsored.t: Provides for the admissibility of a complainant's outcry and disclosures in cases of sexual abuse
sponsored.sum: Provides for the admissibility of a complainant's outcry and disclosures in cases of sexual abuse regardless of when the disclosure was made relative to the abuse.

sponsored.t: Allows medical assistants to administer vaccines
sponsored.sum: Allows medical assistants to administer vaccines while under appropriate supervision of a physician, nurse practitioner or physician assistant.

sponsored.t: Requires an official inspection station to post a sign or poster informing customers that it is not authorized to inspect certain vehicles
sponsored.sum: Requires an official inspection station to post a sign or poster informing customers that it is not authorized to inspect an altered motor vehicle unless the registrant presents a state DOT exemption letter, otherwise, such vehicle shall report to the Department of Transportation.

sponsored.t: Relates to the establishment of regulations for administering immunizations based on the recommendations of certain entities
sponsored.sum: Relates to the establishment of regulations for administering immunizations taking into consideration the recommendations of the American Academy of Pediatrics, the American Academy of Family Physicians, the American College of Obstetricians and Gynecologists, the American College of Physicians, the advisory committee on immunization practices, any interstate body established for purposes of reviewing and making recommendations regarding immunization coverage and access, or other similar nationally or internationally recognized scientific organizations.

sponsored.t: Relates to the rates of payment for certified home health agencies
sponsored.sum: Requires the commissioner of health to annually make the system of episodic payments, including all pricing mechanisms, available to all Medicaid managed care plans, all child health insurance plans and all essential plans, and to notify all such managed care plans of their responsibilities for ensuring that their enrolled members have access to certified home health agency services.

sponsored.t: Automated identification of eligible participants for the Medicare savings program
sponsored.sum: Identifies and enrolls SNAP program participants who are eligible for the Medicare savings program.

sponsored.t: Relates to enrollment in medical assistance programs for incarcerated individuals
sponsored.sum: Provides presumptive eligibility for medical assistance benefits for persons released from correctional facilities for at least sixty days following release; provides for enrollment of such individuals upon release upon application, if eligible.

sponsored.t: Relates to prohibiting the establishment of new for-profit hospices
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the establishment of new for-profit hospices or increasing the capacity of existing for-profit hospices.

sponsored.t: Relates to summaries of readable and understandable insurance policies
sponsored.sum: Relates to summaries of readable and understandable insurance policies which shall include the limits of insurance, the term of the policy, the amount of premium and the amount of deductibles and a statement.

sponsored.t: Relates to the election of school board members after the number of members has been increased
sponsored.sum: Provides that elections to fill an increased number of seats on a school board will be conducted at the first annual meeting after the meeting during which number of seats was increased.

sponsored.t: Relates to pharmacy benefits where a physician is authorized to dispense certain medications and practices medicine in the oncology setting
sponsored.sum: Relates to excepting situations where a physician or other licensed health care provider is authorized to dispense certain medications and is practicing medicine in the oncology setting and is dispensing oncology drugs or drugs related to an approved course of treatment used to manage symptoms related to cancer or cancer therapies.

sponsored.t: Relates to federal qualified health center rate adequacy
sponsored.sum: Provides for the calculation and analysis of certain health center costs.

sponsored.t: Relates to regional minimum hourly base reimbursement rates for home care aides
sponsored.sum: Relates to reimbursement of home care aides; requires the commissioner of health to ensure rate ranges for Medicaid managed care organizations comply with certain reimbursement rates.

sponsored.t: Establishes a sales tax exemption for energy storage
sponsored.sum: Establishes sales tax exemptions for commercial energy storage systems equipment.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing a special needs assisted living demonstration program
sponsored.sum: Establishes a special needs assisted living demonstration program to authorize up to three assisted living programs throughout the state to serve individuals with special needs, including, but not limited to, individuals with dementia or cognitive impairments.

sponsored.t: Requires utility service providers to disclose planned rate increases to consumers within a certain amount of time
sponsored.sum: Requires utility service providers to disclose planned rate increases to consumers within thirty days before a planned price increase takes effect; requires utility providers to provide contact information and a mechanism to cancel service completely.

sponsored.t: Establishes a duty to inform certain patients about the risks associated with cesarean section for patients undergoing planned and unplanned primary cesarean sections
sponsored.sum: Establishes a duty to inform certain patients about the risks associated with cesarean section for patients undergoing a planned or unplanned primary cesarean section.

sponsored.t: Relates to the scheduling of certain providers through the directory
sponsored.sum: Relates to the scheduling of certain providers through the directory.

sponsored.t: Relates to access to palliative care and hospice services
sponsored.sum: Amends policies and procedures to improve access to palliative care and hospice services; directs implementation of hospice-palliative care health system demonstration projects.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the use of infant walkers in child care facilities; repealer
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the use of infant walkers in child care facilities.

sponsored.t: Relates to requirements regarding employers including opioid antagonists where first aid kits are required by federal law
sponsored.sum: Relates to requirements regarding employers including opioid antagonists where first aid kits are required by federal law; amends the effectiveness thereof.

sponsored.t: Provides guidance to certain children and family services and municipal staff on the identification of circumstances that may indicate the presence of controlled substances and referrals to law enforcement
sponsored.sum: Provides guidance to certain staff accepting registrations, issuing licenses or conducting inspections of child day care homes, programs or facilities on the identification of circumstances that may indicate the presence of controlled substances and referrals to law enforcement.

sponsored.t: Requires the state office for the aging to publish a "Guide to Actions When Someone Close Dies"
sponsored.sum: Requires the state office for the aging to publish a "Guide to Actions When Someone Close Dies".

sponsored.t: Authorizes the performance of certain dental hygiene services at voluntary foster care agency health facilities
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the performance of certain dental hygiene services at voluntary foster care agency health facilities by a registered hygienist operating pursuant to a collaborative agreement between such hygienist and a dentist.

sponsored.t: Provides for the declination of a designation as a candidate or nomination for a party position under special circumstance
sponsored.sum: Provides for the declination of a designation as a candidate or nomination for a party position if the person designated or nominated has received a diagnosis of a serious health condition or has resigned the office for which they are nominated or designated to run for re-election.

sponsored.t: Establishes the managed long term care high acuity stabilization pool; appropriation
sponsored.sum: Establishes the managed long term care high acuity stabilization pool to support managed long term care plans that demonstrate high performance on quality measures established by the department and serve a disproportionately high share of members with complex long term care needs or high service utilization.

sponsored.t: Permits the use of cremation or natural organic reduction as the method of disposition for certain decedents
sponsored.sum: Permits a chief fiscal officer of a county or a public administrator, when having the right to control the disposition of the remains of a decedent and acting reasonably and in good faith, to, without civil liability, select cremation or natural organic reduction as the method of disposition for such decedent where the financial resources of such decedent are limited and such disposition is selected with the reasonable belief that the method is consistent with the religious practices of the decedent.

sponsored.t: Relates to limiting audit and review of certain medical assistance program funds
sponsored.sum: Limits the reimbursement amount of certain overpayment claims and reviews where such overpayment was due to the provider's submission of records which were not in accordance with program requirements at the time but which were in accordance with current requirements as a result of changes to guidelines or regulations.

sponsored.t: Relates to coverage for services provided by school-based health centers for medical assistance recipients
sponsored.sum: Ensures services provided in school-based health centers are not provided to medical assistance recipients through managed care programs.

sponsored.t: Relates to foreign adoptions
sponsored.sum: Removes the 18 year old age limitation for the adoption of a foreign-born person.

sponsored.t: Relates to the medical aid in dying act
sponsored.sum: Relates to the medical aid in dying act; relates to a terminally ill patient's request for and use of medication for medical aid in dying.

appr.text: APPROVAL MEMORANDUM - No. 89 Chapter 714 MEMORANDUM filed with Assembly Bill Number 136, entitled: "AN ACT to amend the public health law, in relation to a terminally ill patient's request for and use of medication for medical aid in dying" APPROVED New York has long been a beacon of freedom. This bill seeks to extend that freedom to terminally ill New Yorkers who want the right to die comfortably and on their own terms. My mother died of ALS, and I am all too familiar with the pain of seeing someone you love suffer and being powerless to stop it. Therefore, after careful reflection and deliber- ation with this bill's sponsors, advocacy organizations, and, most importantly, New Yorkers with personal experiences to share, I have decided to sign this bill, which makes medical aid in dying available to terminally ill New Yorkers with less than six months to live. The bill, as passed by the…

sponsored.t: Relates to requirements for the provision of medication for medical aid in dying
sponsored.sum: Relates to requirements for medical professionals and health care facilities that provide medication to patients for medical aid in dying; extends the initial effectiveness of certain provisions relating thereto.

sponsored.t: Establishes a quality incentive program for managed care providers
sponsored.sum: Establishes a quality incentive program for managed care providers that is distributed based on managed care providers' performance in meeting quality objectives.

sponsored.t: Relates to conditions under which certain residential health care facilities may withdraw equity or assets totaling five percent of reported annual revenue for patient care services without prior notification
sponsored.sum: Relates to conditions under which non-public residential health care facilities may withdraw equity or assets totaling five percent of total reported annual revenue for patient care services without prior notification to the commissioner of health.

sponsored.t: Relates to the collection and reporting of sexual offense evidence on the statewide electronic tracking system
sponsored.sum: Requires the collection and reporting of sexual offense evidence on the statewide electronic tracking system within ten days of permission to release the evidence by the alleged sexual offense victim; relates to the effectiveness thereof.

sponsored.t: Relates to value-based care for maternity coverage
sponsored.sum: Requires contracts for insurance and medical assistance to provide value-based care for maternity coverage; defines value-based care as an arrangement that financially rewards certain positive outcomes and financially penalizes certain negative outcomes.

sponsored.t: Establishes a competitive emergency mapping grant program
sponsored.sum: Establishes a competitive emergency mapping grant program which will provide grants to school districts or boards of cooperative educational services to upgrade their floor plans, blueprints, schematics or other maps of their school interior, school grounds and road maps of the immediate surrounding area included in their building level emergency response plans.

sponsored.t: Amends the definition of automated external defibrillators
sponsored.sum: Amends the definition of automated external defibrillator to remove the requirement that an action be taken by an operator before delivering an appropriate electrical impulse to the patient's heart to perform defibrillation.

sponsored.t: Relates to the organization of the Port Authority
sponsored.ls: Port Authority of New York and New Jersey
sponsored.sum: Relates to port authority organization, appearance and notice.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "licensed funeral arranger act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "licensed funeral arranger act" under which a "licensed funeral arranger" license allows a funeral arranger to perform all acts permitted to a funeral director except embalming or any preservation of the body of a deceased person requiring embalming; creates a registration process under which registered transporters facilitate the removal and transportation of the bodies of deceased persons.

sponsored.t: Provides outpatient insurance coverage for non-pharmacological treatments and non-opioid drugs for chronic pain
sponsored.sum: Provides outpatient insurance coverage for non-pharmacological treatments and non-opioid drugs for chronic pain.

sponsored.t: Excludes certain medication abortion drugs from being deemed unlawful to prescribe or dispense and from being deemed misbranded under certain circumstances
sponsored.sum: Provides that the prescribing, dispensing, or receipt of mifepristone or any drug used for medication abortion shall not be considered a criminal conversion act under certain circumstances; provides that mifepristone or any drug used for medication abortion shall not be deemed to be adulterated or misbranded under certain circumstances.

sponsored.t: Relates to oversight of continuing care communities; repealer
sponsored.sum: Amends provisions for oversight of continuing care retirement communities.

sponsored.t: Amends the effectiveness of provisions related to permitting a close friend to make an anatomical gift of a decedent's body
sponsored.sum: Amends the effectiveness of provisions related to permitting a close friend to make an anatomical gift of a decedent's body.

sponsored.t: Relates to contracts and dispute resolution process for billing under contracts for home care services with managed care plans
sponsored.sum: Requires review and approval by the commissioner of health of contracts for home care services provided to a licensed home care services agency from a managed care organization or a managed long term care plan; directs the commissioner of health to establish a dispute resolution process independent dispute resolution relating to billing under a contract for home care services.

sponsored.t: Relates to payment for work by a personal care aide or a home health aide with temporary protected status or other visa status
sponsored.sum: Requires insurers to pay a licensed home care services agency for work provided by a personal care aide or a home health aide with temporary protected status or other visa status; requires the licensed home services agency to have made a good faith effort to establish the employment eligibility of personal care aide or a home health aide consistent with federal regulation and statutes.

sponsored.t: Relates to vaccines and immunizations of children
sponsored.sum: Requires the administration of certain vaccines for children in accordance with regulations issued by the commissioner, utilizing generally accepted medical standards and based on recommendations of the American Academy of Pediatrics, the American Academy of Family Physicians, the American College of Obstetricians and Gynecologists, the American College of Physicians, the Advisory Committee on Immunization Practices, or other similar nationally or internationally recognized scientific organizations.

sponsored.t: Removes the requirement that consent for the payment of certain medical services must occur after such services are administered
sponsored.sum: Removes the requirement that consent for the payment of certain medical services must occur after such services are administered; requires the superintendent of financial services and the commissioner of health to develop a uniform form for consent for payment.

sponsored.t: Authorizes certain patients to use medical cannabis at certain health care facilities
sponsored.sum: Authorizes certain patients who are terminally ill to use medical cannabis at hospitals and nursing homes.

sponsored.t: Requires persons the ages of 16 or 17 to wear a helmet when riding a class one or class two bicycle with electric assist
sponsored.sum: Requires persons the ages of 16 or 17 to wear a helmet when riding a class one or class two bicycle with electric assist.

sponsored.t: Prohibits unsolicited telemarketing sales calls during certain declared states of emergency
sponsored.sum: Prohibits unsolicited telemarketing sales calls during a declared state of emergency or disaster emergency where the declaration or proclamation of emergency includes a finding that unsolicited telemarketing sales calls would impair actions taken to limit, control, or mitigate the emergency; explains the basis of such finding; provides that such prohibition may not extend for a period of more than two weeks, subject to renewal for additional two-week periods by further findings of necessity made at the end of each two-week period.

sponsored.t: Establishes the rare disease advisory council
sponsored.sum: Establishes the rare disease advisory council to identify best practices, raise awareness regarding rare diseases, evaluate barriers to access to care, and to make recommendations to the legislature and the governor.

sponsored.t: Relates to long term care options for medicaid recipients; repealer
sponsored.sum: Repeals managed long term care provisions for Medicaid recipients; establishes provisions for fully integrated plans for long term care including PACE and MAP plans.

sponsored.t: Relates to Medicaid reimbursement rates for private duty nursing
sponsored.sum: Relates to Medicaid reimbursement rates for private duty nursing; requires DOH to publish a private duty rate schedule.

sponsored.t: Relates to creating the health emergency response data system
sponsored.sum: Relates to creating the health emergency response data system, which collects information and statistical data relating to public health emergencies in order to assist the department of health, other government entities, health care providers, and the public in understanding and responding to public health emergencies.

sponsored.t: Allows evidence of a defendant's prior crimes or acts to be admissible in a criminal case for certain purposes
sponsored.sum: Allows evidence of a defendant's prior crimes or acts to be admissible in a criminal case for certain purposes including as proof of motive, opportunity, intent, preparation, plan, knowledge, state of mind of the defendant, state of mind of the victim or other party, absence of mistake or accident, identity, modus operandi, or common scheme or plan; requires that the prosecution provide reasonable notice of the general nature of any such evidence it intends to introduce at trial.

sponsored.t: Authorizes a school district in the village of Tuckahoe, by resolution, to limit transportation of students to 7 miles
sponsored.sum: Authorizes a school district in the village of Tuckahoe, by resolution, to limit transportation of students to 7 miles.

sponsored.t: Requires disclosure of information concerning non-invasive prenatal screening for chromosomal abnormalities
sponsored.sum: Requires disclosure of information concerning non-invasive prenatal screening for chromosomal abnormalities including the benefits and limitations of non-invasive prenatal testing, the difference between non-invasive prenatal testing and prenatal diagnostic testing, and current recommendations from the American College of Obstetricians and Gynecologists (ACOG), the Society for Maternal Fetal Medicine, and the American College of Medical Genetics and Genomics (ACMG).

sponsored.t: Adds ammunition to the list of prohibited items to purchase or dispose of after certain convictions
sponsored.sum: Relates to adding ammunition to the list of prohibited items to purchase or dispose of after certain convictions.

sponsored.t: Relates to a review of reimbursement adequacy for early intervention services
sponsored.sum: Directs the commissioner of health to contract with an independent entity to conduct a comprehensive assessment of the existing methodology used to determine payment for early intervention screenings, evaluations, services and service coordination; directs recommendations on reimbursement methodology as well as needs under the program.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing the crime of fertility fraud
sponsored.sum: Establishes the crime of fertility fraud as an assisted reproduction procedure using the health care provider's own spermatozoon or ovum or using human reproductive material without the donor's consent.

sponsored.t: Relates to amending the universal full-day pre-kindergarten program subscription amount for regions other than New York city; repealer
sponsored.sum: Relates to amending the universal full-day pre-kindergarten program subscription amount for regions other than New York city.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring orders of custody to state whether law enforcement is authorized to remove a child or children
sponsored.sum: Requires orders of custody to state whether law enforcement is authorized to remove a child or children in order to comply with and enforce such orders.

sponsored.t: Relates to the date for change of enrollment
sponsored.sum: Relates to the postmark date for change of enrollment.

sponsored.t: Requires the surrender of antique firearms, black powder rifles, black powder shotguns, or muzzle-loading firearms following certain convictions
sponsored.sum: Requires the surrender of antique firearms, black powder rifles, black powder shotguns, or muzzle-loading firearms following a conviction for a felony or serious offense or following a report pursuant to section 9.46 of the mental hygiene law.

sponsored.t: Prohibits smoking tobacco in motor vehicles where minors less than 18 years of age are passengers in such vehicles; traffic infraction
sponsored.sum: Prohibits smoking tobacco in motor vehicles where a minor less than 18 years of age is a passenger in such vehicle; provides for rebuttable presumption.

sponsored.t: Relates to lottery aid formulas for school districts
sponsored.sum: Relates to lottery aid formulas for school districts.

sponsored.t: Provides that limited liability for persons held jointly liable shall not apply to parties held liable for failing to provide reasonable security
sponsored.sum: Provides that limited liability for persons held jointly liable shall not apply to parties held liable for failing to provide reasonable security or failing to provide security required by federal, state or local law, rules or regulations.

sponsored.t: Establishes the offense of unlawful possession of firearms by persons under twenty-one
sponsored.sum: Establishes the offense of unlawful possession of firearms by persons under twenty-one.

sponsored.t: Empowers the commissioner of a board of elections to order certain audits upon a finding of discrepancies
sponsored.sum: Relates to empowering the commissioner of a board of elections to order a voting machine audit upon a finding of discrepancies and shall also be empowered to order an audit of a particular contest.

sponsored.t: Relates to drivers of school buses using hands-free mobile telephones
sponsored.sum: Prohibits drivers of school buses that are carrying students from using hands-free mobile telephones; provides for certain exceptions.

sponsored.t: Relates to surplus funds
sponsored.sum: Provides that for the two thousand twenty-six--two thousand twenty-seven school year, the two thousand twenty-seven--two thousand twenty-eight school year, and the two thousand twenty-eight--two thousand twenty-nine school year, surplus funds as used in this subdivision shall mean any operating funds in excess of five percent of the current school year budget, and shall not include funds properly retained under other sections of law.

sponsored.t: Adds a school business official to the Teachers' Retirement System (TRS) Board
sponsored.sum: Adds a school business official to the Teachers' Retirement System (TRS) Board.

sponsored.t: Establishes a parking placard review board
sponsored.sum: Establishes a parking placard review board to undertake a review of the impact of parking placard use within the city of New York.

sponsored.t: Directs social services districts to contract with non-residential programs for victims of domestic violence to provide outreach and education in high schools
sponsored.sum: Directs social services districts to contract with non-residential programs for victims of domestic violence to provide outreach and education to students in public and private high schools; provides for state reimbursement therefor.

sponsored.t: Relates to designating blighted property and blighted areas; provides definition of blighted property and blighted areas; amends definition of substandard or insanitary area
sponsored.sum: Relates to designating blighted property and blighted areas; establishes criteria for designation; provides definition of blighted property and blighted areas; amends definition of substandard or insanitary area by removing the words "slum" and "deteriorated or deteriorating".

sponsored.t: Establishes a nonpartisan poll monitoring program
sponsored.sum: Establishes a nonpartisan poll monitoring program.

sponsored.t: Relates to the issuance of distinctive plates for retired members of the New York state legislature
sponsored.sum: Relates to the issuance of distinctive plates for retired members of the New York state legislature.

sponsored.t: Entitles employees 45 years of age or older to take one day every ten years to undergo a colonoscopy
sponsored.sum: Entitles employees 45 years of age or older to take one day off every ten years to undergo a colonoscopy.

sponsored.t: Relates to the department of transportation not requiring surveying in certain situations
sponsored.sum: Provides that the department of transportation shall not require a survey as part of an agreement with any fiber optic utility for use and occupancy of a state right of way for the purposes of installing, modifying, relocating, repairing, operating, or maintaining fiber optic facilities as part of the department's consolidated application, when such use and occupancy of the state right of way is utilizing existing infrastructure, including but not limited to aerial pole attachments and underground conduits.

sponsored.t: Relates to state agency contracts with not-for-profit corporations
sponsored.sum: Defines noncompliant state agency; provides for timelines and procedures for state agency contracts involving not-for-profit corporations.

sponsored.t: Relates to Eastchester fire district elections
sponsored.sum: Relates to Eastchester fire district elections; follows provisions of election law instead of town law for elections.

sponsored.t: Relates to unconsented removal or tampering with a sexually protective device
sponsored.sum: Relates to unconsented removal or tampering with a sexually protective device.

sponsored.t: Relates to the availability of agency records prior to or at an open meeting
sponsored.sum: Relates to the availability of agency records prior to or at an open meeting; removes the "to the extent practicable at least twenty-four hours" limitation from the requirement that agencies and departments shall make records available.

sponsored.t: Establishes a cause of action for fertility fraud
sponsored.sum: Establishes a cause of action for fertility fraud; allows patients who have undergone assisted reproduction procedures to bring a cause of action if human reproductive material other than that which was consented to by the patient is used in such procedure; allows for compensatory and punitive damages.

sponsored.t: Relates to the distribution of the foreign and alien fire insurance premium tax
sponsored.sum: Relates to the distribution of the foreign and alien fire insurance premium tax; provides amount received shall be distributed to the fire companies in proportion to the number of active members within each company.

sponsored.t: Establishes a ranked choice voting method for presidential elections
sponsored.sum: Establishes a ranked choice voting method for presidential elections whereby voters rank candidates according to the order of their choice and, if no candidate has received a majority of votes, the candidate with the fewest first choice votes is eliminated and the remaining candidates advance to another counting round until a winner is determined.

sponsored.t: Relates to speed limits for any portion of a highway within a city, village or town park
sponsored.sum: Authorizes legislative bodies to establish speed limits not less than fifteen miles per hour for any portion of a highway within a city, village or town park.

sponsored.t: Relates to requests for proposals for voting machines
sponsored.sum: Relates to requests for proposals for voting machines and contracts for the purchase of voting machines or systems.

sponsored.t: Relates to application and environmental assessment forms
sponsored.sum: Relates to application and environmental assessment forms and city and village planning commissions.

sponsored.t: Prohibits executive sessions for the appointment of elected office
sponsored.sum: Prohibits public bodies from conducting an executive session where the subject to be considered relates to the appointment of an elected member or officer to fill a vacancy in an elected office of such public body, including interviews of prospective appointees and related discussions.

sponsored.t: Repeals chapter 104 of the laws of 1936, relating to providing for the establishment, organization and operation of police departments in the towns of Westchester county
sponsored.sum: Relates to providing for the establishment, organization and operation of police departments in the towns of Westchester county.

sponsored.t: Relates to the creation of a school-based teen dating violence prevention program
sponsored.sum: Relates to the creation of a school-based teen dating violence prevention program designed to be incorporated into a school district's existing health curriculum to prevent and reduce the incidence and prevalence of teen dating violence.

sponsored.t: Relates to a negotiated sentence of imprisonment
sponsored.sum: Provides that a pre-sentence investigation and written report thereon shall not be required where a negotiated sentence of imprisonment for a term of three hundred sixty-five days or less has been mutually agreed upon by the parties with consent of the judge, as a result of a conviction or revocation of a sentence of probation; removes the requirement of solely in a city with a population of one million or more.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring helicopters be equipped with flight recorders, cockpit voice recorders and terrain awareness and warning systems
sponsored.sum: Requires helicopters be equipped with flight recorders, cockpit voice recorders and terrain awareness and warning systems.

sponsored.t: Requires ticket distributors to refund the purchase price of tickets within forty-five days after a cancelled or rescheduled event
sponsored.sum: Requires ticket distributors to refund the purchase price of tickets within forty-five days after a cancelled or rescheduled event.

sponsored.t: Allows a notice of dense breast tissue to be determination of medical necessity for coverage of a breast ultrasound
sponsored.sum: Allows a notice of dense breast tissue to be considered a determination of medical necessity for purposes of coverage of breast ultrasounds as recommended by a provider of mammography services.

sponsored.t: Requires public bodies to ensure that proceedings of meetings are audible for individuals in person and via broadcast
sponsored.sum: Requires public bodies to make reasonable efforts to ensure that proceedings of meetings are audible for individuals in person and via broadcast and to provide audio visual equipment as necessary.

sponsored.t: Relates to the proper venue for an impounding organization to file a petition for a security
sponsored.sum: Relates to the proper venue for an impounding organization to file a petition for a security to be paid by the owner of a seized animal currently in the care of such organization.

sponsored.t: Increases the penalty for multiple convictions of torturing or failing to provide sustenance to an animal
sponsored.sum: Increases the penalty for multiple convictions of torturing, killing or failing to provide sustenance to an animal to a felony, if convicted within five years from the date of a prior conviction.

sponsored.t: Amends the definitions of pet dealers
sponsored.sum: Amends the definitions of pet dealers; decreases the number of animals a person can distribute to fit under the exemption.

sponsored.t: Provides for accountability in state assessments to determine graduation, grade promotion or adequate yearly progress
sponsored.sum: Provides for accountability in state assessments by creating a regents review board to audit assessments used to determine grade promotion, graduation and adequate yearly progress by requiring a written report, implementation of an auditing and review of pilot and/or field testing of the standardized tests used to ensure validity, reliability, alignment to standards and appropriateness of use.

sponsored.t: Relates to the former crime of loitering for the purpose of engaging in a prostitution offense and expunges criminal records for persons previously convicted of such crime
sponsored.sum: Relates to the former crime of loitering for the purpose of engaging in a prostitution offense; expunges criminal records for persons previously convicted of such crime; directs the chief administrator of the courts to provide information regarding such expungement; adds language to identify that the crime of loitering for the purpose of engaging in a prostitution offense is no longer in law.

sponsored.t: Relates to publishing records of public interest by agencies and the legislature
sponsored.sum: Relates to publishing records of public interest by agencies and the legislature on their websites.

sponsored.t: Requires that certain motor vehicles shall be equipped with operable carbon monoxide detectors
sponsored.sum: Requires that for hire vehicles with a chassis which was manufactured and then altered for the purpose of transporting ten or more occupants, including the driver, be equipped with an operable carbon monoxide detector.

sponsored.t: Requires kindergarten instruction for Rockland and Westchester counties for minors who are five years of age on or before December first
sponsored.sum: Requires kindergarten instruction for Rockland and Westchester counties for minors who are five years of age on or before December first.

sponsored.t: Establishes a pilot program for the field testing of mobile phones and portable devices for the county of Westchester
sponsored.sum: Establishes optional pilot programs for the county of Westchester, for local police departments to use electronic scanning devices to determine whether or not the operator of a vehicle was using a mobile phone or portable electronic device near the time of an accident or collision.

sponsored.t: Provides that a court may require that a new election be held when there is clear and convincing evidence that the wrong candidate was determined to be the winner
sponsored.sum: Provides that a court may require that a new election be held when there is clear and convincing evidence that the wrong candidate was determined to be the winner.

sponsored.t: Establishes the city of White Plains industrial development agency and provides for its functions, powers, and duties
sponsored.sum: Establishes the city of White Plains industrial development agency and provides for its functions, powers, and duties.

sponsored.t: Provides for certain limited direct interstate shipments of wine for off-premises consumption
sponsored.sum: Provides for certain limited direct interstate shipments by retail licensees to sell wine for off-premises consumption.

sponsored.t: Requires the budget submitted by the governor to include an itemization, by each individual school district, of appropriations for the support of school districts
sponsored.sum: Requires the budget submitted by the governor to include an itemization, by each individual school district, of appropriations for the support of school districts.

sponsored.t: Requires registration of general aviation aircrafts
sponsored.sum: Requires registration of general aviation aircrafts; aircrafts used for civil aviation; issuance of certificates of registration; proof of insurance.

sponsored.t: Relates to the authority of the state board of elections to issue subpoenas
sponsored.sum: Relates to the authority of the state board of elections to issue subpoenas; directs the board of elections to issue rules and regulations.

sponsored.t: Creates the offense of operating as a major firearms trafficker
sponsored.sum: Establishes the class A-I felony of operating as a major firearms trafficker.

sponsored.t: Relates to vested rights of property owners relating to the development of their land in the counties of Dutchess, Orange, Putnam, Rockland and Westchester
sponsored.sum: Relates to vested rights of property owners relating to the development of their land in the counties of Dutchess, Orange, Putnam, Rockland and Westchester; requires notice by applicant to property owners within 250 feet of land development application; provides for the repeal of such provisions six years after they take effect.

sponsored.t: Relates to bail and domestic violence charges
sponsored.sum: Requires the consideration of certain domestic violence charges when imposing bail.

sponsored.t: Relates to energy services companies
sponsored.sum: Relates to energy services companies; authorizes ESCO's to only enroll new or renew existing residential or small non-residential customers in gas or electric service if certain conditions are met.

sponsored.t: Establishes "The Equity in Fertility Treatment Act"; relates to the definition of infertility and health insurance coverage for the treatment of infertility
sponsored.sum: Establishes "The Equity in Fertility Treatment Act"; relates to the definition of infertility and health insurance coverage for the treatment of infertility.

sponsored.t: Relates to site mapping for emergency response data and school safety plans
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the provision of site mapping for emergency response data with school safety plans; provides for the funding of such mapping data.

sponsored.t: Exempts a person from a money judgment arising from an action in another state for knowingly engaging in conduct that aids or abets the performance or inducement of an abortion
sponsored.sum: Exempts a person from a money judgment arising from an action in another state for knowingly engaging in conduct that aids or abets the performance or inducement of an abortion.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the study of aviation ownership and flight operations by the department of transportation
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the study of aviation flight operations by the department of transportation; requires reporting.

sponsored.t: Relates to increasing monetary penalties for public health law violations
sponsored.sum: Increases monetary penalties for public health law violations; provides support for the nursing home quality improvement demonstration program.

sponsored.t: Allows a judicial district convention to be conducted in whole or in part via video conference
sponsored.sum: Allows a judicial district convention to be conducted in whole or in part via video conference upon a minimum of seventy-two hours notice to the members of the respective committee by mail, an appropriately titled email, text or telephone call at an address or number expressly provided in writing for the purpose of receiving such notices.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "donor conceived person protection act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "donor-conceived person protection act" to ensure that reproductive tissue banks, licensed by the department of health, collect and verify medical information from any donor it procures reproductive tissue from and to disseminate such information to a recipient before a recipient purchases or otherwise receives such tissue, and to donor-conceived persons, if any, when such persons turn eighteen years of age or earlier upon consent of the recipient parent or guardian; defines terms; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Provides for the licensing of pet grooming facilities; establishes standards of care and required record keeping
sponsored.sum: Provides for the licensing of pet grooming facilities; establishes standards of care and required record keeping.

sponsored.t: Establishes regional minimum hourly base reimbursement rates for home care aides
sponsored.sum: Requires the commissioner of health to establish regional minimum hourly base reimbursement rates for home care aides.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing the professional practice of certified midwifery
sponsored.sum: Establishes the professional practice of community midwifery; defines as the management in the home, birth center, or community setting, of normal pregnancies, child birth, and postpartum care, including newborn evaluation, resuscitation and referral for infants; sets requirements for license and practice.

sponsored.t: Provides access to medical marihuana for animals
sponsored.sum: Provides access to medical marihuana for an animal when a veterinarian determines such animal has any medical condition that may benefit from treatment with medical marihuana.

sponsored.t: Relates to the definition of class two bicycles with electric assist
sponsored.sum: Specifies that class two bicycles with electric assist shall be those for which the electric motor cannot provide assistance when such bicycles reach a speed of twenty-eight miles per hour.

sponsored.t: Requires kindergartens to operate full day programs
sponsored.sum: Requires kindergartens to operate full day programs in the 2027-2028 school year.

sponsored.t: Repeals certain provisions of the vehicle and traffic law relating to the operation of bicycles with electric assist
sponsored.sum: Repeals certain provisions relating to the operation of bicycles with electric assist.

sponsored.t: Authorizes rate increases for in-person early intervention services
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the commissioner of health to increase rates by 11 percent for in-person early intervention services commencing July 1, 2026.

sponsored.t: Provides for interest to accrue on missed installment payments beginning from the due date of such missed installment payment
sponsored.sum: Provides for interest to accrue on missed installment payments beginning from the due date of such missed installment payment.

sponsored.t: Relates to making restaurant and bar patios one hundred percent smoke free; repealer
sponsored.sum: Relates to making restaurant and bar patios one hundred percent smoke free.

sponsored.t: Relates to exempting heat and power generating equipment from taxation
sponsored.sum: Establishes that combined heat and power generating equipment shall be exempt from taxation.

sponsored.t: Requires stretch limousines to be retired from use after ten years from manufacture or the accumulation of three hundred fifty thousand miles
sponsored.sum: Requires stretch limousines to be retired from use after ten years from manufacture or the accumulation of three hundred fifty thousand miles, whichever comes first.

sponsored.t: Relates to prohibited hospital interference with patient care
sponsored.sum: Prohibits hospital interference with patient care where the practitioner is acting in good faith and within the scope of their practice; defines emergency medical conditions; requires appropriate medical screening and stabilizing treatment of persons in an emergency department, including pregnant persons, or appropriate transfer.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the dispensing of abortion medication
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the dispensing of abortion medication under certain conditions; requires insurance policies providing coverage for contraception to provide coverage for abortion medication.

sponsored.t: Prohibits fuel oil, grade number four in any building or facility in the state
sponsored.sum: Prohibits fuel oil, grade number four in any building or facility in the state after July 1, 2030.

sponsored.t: Limits tinted green and brown to compostable plastic bags for the purposes of bag waste reduction
sponsored.sum: Provides that bags exempt from bag waste reduction shall not be tinted green or brown unless it is a compostable plastic bag.

sponsored.t: Relates to eligibility for home care services under medicaid; repealer
sponsored.sum: Removes certain restrictions on eligibility for personal and home care services under medicaid.

sponsored.t: Requires transportation network companies to notify passengers who have reported an incident of sexual assault of certain information
sponsored.sum: Requires transportation network companies to notify passengers who have reported an incident of sexual assault that occurred during a TNC prearranged trip that the TNC will not report such incident to law enforcement; requires TNCs to advise every passenger that reports an incident of sexual assault that occurred during a TNC prearranged trip of their right to make a report to local law enforcement or the state police.

sponsored.t: Relates to the calculation of voting power for committee members in districts that have changed or new districts
sponsored.sum: Relates to the calculation of voting power for committee members in districts that have changed or new districts since the last preceding gubernatorial election.

sponsored.t: Provides for the applicability of provisions governing referral of certain municipal planning and zoning actions to counties operating under a county charter
sponsored.sum: Provides for the applicability of provisions governing referral of certain municipal planning and zoning actions to county planning agencies or regional planning councils to all counties, including counties operating under a county charter, except counties wholly contained within a city.

sponsored.t: Enacts safety requirements in stretch limousines including anti-intrusion bars and window break tools
sponsored.sum: Enacts safety requirements in stretch limousines including anti-intrusion bars and window break tools; reduces occupancy of omnibuses for purposes of being equipped with fire extinguishers and additional mirrors.

sponsored.t: Relates to supervision by certain nurse practitioners; makes certain provisions permanent relating to nurse practitioners
sponsored.sum: Relates to supervision by certain nurse practitioners; makes certain provisions permanent relating to nurse practitioners.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing a carbon dioxide emissions price for electric generation from carbon-based fuel and creating a carbon dioxide emissions fund
sponsored.sum: Establishes a carbon dioxide emissions price for electric generation from carbon-based fuel; creates a carbon dioxide emissions fund.

sponsored.t: Relates to the definition of office and the content of notices published in newspapers
sponsored.sum: Relates to the definition of office and the content of notices published in newspapers.

sponsored.t: Relates to drivers of buses, taxis and livery vehicles using hands-free mobile telephones
sponsored.sum: Prohibits drivers of a bus, taxi or livery from using hands-free mobile telephones; provides for certain exceptions.

sponsored.t: Relates to the submission of claims for services provided by home care agencies
sponsored.sum: Provides that the submission of claims for services provided by home care agencies shall be done on forms approved by the centers for Medicare and Medicaid services.

sponsored.t: Relates to the practice of physicians licensed in another state or territory of the United States pursuant to a reciprocal agreement
sponsored.sum: Authorizes physicians licensed in another state or territory of the United States to practice time-limited follow-up care via telehealth in NYS pursuant to a reciprocal agreement; requires annual authorization.

sponsored.t: Relates to the crimes of commercial bribery and larceny
sponsored.sum: Removes the $250 economic harm requirement from the felony commercial bribery statutes; expands the crime of larceny to include theft of personal identifying information, computer data, computer programs, and services, to adapt to modern technological realities; provides state jurisdiction and county venue over cases involving larceny of personal identifying information, computer data, and computer programs, where the victim is located in the state or the county.

sponsored.t: Relates to when the department of transportation may require surveys for fiber optics
sponsored.sum: Provides that the department of transportation shall not require a survey from any fiber optic utility for permitting or continuance of the use and occupancy of a state right of way for the purposes of installing, modifying, relocating, repairing, operating, or maintaining fiber optic facilities, under certain circumstances.

sponsored.t: Relates to reciprocity agreements with other states for medical cannabis programs
sponsored.sum: Provides for reciprocity agreements with other states for medical cannabis programs; directs the cannabis control board to promulgate regulations for the approval of pre-roll products in the medical cannabis program.

sponsored.t: Authorizes collaborative programs for community paramedicine services
sponsored.sum: Authorizes collaborative programs for community paramedicine services as part of the hospital-home care-physician collaboration program.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the fingerprinting of employees of informal child care providers
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the fingerprinting of employees of informal child care providers; defines terms; provides that an informal child care provider means a program in a facility, other than a residence, in which child care is provided on a regular basis and is not required to be licensed by or registered with the office or licensed by the city of New York.

sponsored.t: Authorizes a prenatal and postpartum informational mobile application
sponsored.sum: Authorizes a prenatal and postpartum informational mobile application for individuals who are eligible for Medicaid.

sponsored.t: Expands felony sex offenses to include certain offenses related to prostitution and human trafficking
sponsored.sum: Expands felony sex offenses to include promoting prostitution in the second degree, promoting prostitution in the first degree, compelling prostitution, sex trafficking, and sex trafficking of a child.

sponsored.t: Prohibits state-operated hospitals from suing patients for medical debt
sponsored.sum: Prohibits state-operated hospitals from suing patients for medical debt; defines "medical debt".

sponsored.t: Relates to the establishment of rates of payment for medical assistance for needy persons
sponsored.sum: Requires the commissioner of health to set rates of payment for medical assistance for needy persons to reflect more current base year information.

sponsored.t: Relates to certain rates of payment for services provided by assisted living programs
sponsored.sum: Provides that such rates of payment shall be updated to reflect the most current mean price for free-standing residential health care facilities with less than three hundred beds each time that the cost basis of residential health care facility rates is updated.

sponsored.t: Limits reversals for failure of prompt prosecution under certain circumstances
sponsored.sum: Limits reversals for failure of prompt prosecution where there is no violation of periods of limitations, speedy trial time periods, and no showing of material prejudice resulting from unreasonable delay.

sponsored.t: Relates to the use of psychotropic medications in nursing homes and adult care facilities
sponsored.sum: Relates to the use of antipsychotic medications in nursing homes; imposes limits as to time and documentation; requires informed consent under certain circumstances.

sponsored.t: Provides for establishment of the New York Health plan
sponsored.sum: Establishes the New York Health program, a comprehensive system of access to health insurance for New York state residents; provides for administrative structure of the plan; provides for powers and duties of the board of trustees, the scope of benefits, payment methodologies and care coordination; establishes the New York Health Trust Fund which would hold monies from a variety of sources to be used solely to finance the plan; enacts provisions relating to financing of New York Health, including a payroll assessment, similar to the Medicare tax; establishes a temporary commission on implementation of the plan; provides for collective negotiations by health care providers with New York…

sponsored.t: Relates to state aid for home health care to meet community need
sponsored.sum: Provides for state aid for home health care and hospice services to meet community need.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring certain child passengers in a taxi or livery to be restrained by a child restraint system
sponsored.sum: Requires that no person under four years of age shall be a passenger in a taxi or livery unless such person is restrained by a child restraint system; requires that no person four years of age or older but under age eight shall be a passenger in a taxi or livery unless such person is restrained in an appropriate child restraint system; establishes violations of such provisions shall be punished by a civil fine of up to fifty dollars.

sponsored.t: Relates to the application of bail in certain prostitution and labor trafficking cases
sponsored.sum: Authorizes courts to order remand or bail in certain prostitution and labor trafficking cases.

sponsored.t: Expands health care services provided by telehealth
