sponsored.sum: Expands health care services provided by telehealth to include services delivered through a facility licensed under article twenty-eight of the public health law that is eligible to be designated or has received a designation as a federally qualified health center, including those facilities that are also licensed under article thirty-one or article thirty-two of the mental hygiene law.

sponsored.t: Relates to creating a private right of action for unconsented removal or tampering with a sexually protective device
sponsored.sum: Relates to creating a private right of action for unconsented removal or tampering with a sexually protective device.

sponsored.t: Establishes a hyperbaric oxygen therapy pilot program
sponsored.sum: Establishes a hyperbaric oxygen therapy pilot program to treat veterans suffering from traumatic brain injuries and post-traumatic stress disorder.

sponsored.t: Requires rear occupant alert systems in certain vehicles
sponsored.sum: Requires rear occupant alert systems in certain vehicles.

sponsored.t: Relates to including the services and care of school psychologists under Medicaid
sponsored.sum: Provides medicaid coverage for the services and care of school psychologists.

sponsored.t: Relates to hospital compliance with federal hospital price transparency law, rules and regulations
sponsored.sum: Requires quarterly reporting on hospital compliance with federal hospital price transparency law, rules and regulations; establishes a civil penalty for non-compliance.

sponsored.t: Restricts consecutive hours of work for health care workers
sponsored.sum: Restricts consecutive hours of work for health care workers except in the case of certain emergencies and surgical procedures.

sponsored.t: Allows access to juvenile delinquency records for the purposes of a firearm background check and authorizes the denial of a firearm license for applicants under thirty who committed certain offenses as a juvenile
sponsored.sum: Allows access to juvenile delinquency records for the purposes of a firearm background check; authorizes the denial of a firearm license for an applicant who is under the age of thirty and who as a juvenile was adjudicated delinquent for an offense which, if committed by an adult, would constitute a felony or serious offense.

sponsored.t: Eliminates a look-back period for home care for non-institutionalized Medicaid applicants; and repeals a certain provision of the social services law relating thereto
sponsored.sum: Eliminates the "look-back period" for home care for non-institutionalized Medicaid applicants; repeals a certain provision of law relating thereto.

sponsored.t: Expands protections regarding violations of safety conditions in adult care facilities
sponsored.sum: Expands protections regarding violations of safety conditions in adult care facilities; provides penalties for safety violations and operating without a valid license; prohibits reductions in fines in certain circumstances where a patient is endangered or harmed.

sponsored.t: Requires audits by hand recount of voter verifiable audit records
sponsored.sum: Requires audits by hand recount of voter verifiable audit records.

sponsored.t: Relates to the development and approval of reimbursement rates for managed care providers under medicaid
sponsored.sum: Requires notice and additional review for managed care providers of the methodologies and fee schedules and other materials used for determining medicaid reimbursement rates.

sponsored.t: Relates to prior authorization and payments from the medical indemnity fund
sponsored.sum: Requires any regulation that mandates prior authorization to establish a mechanism for submission of requests for prior authorization by health care providers directly to the medical indemnity fund; requires the medical indemnity fund administrator to notify qualified plaintiffs which costs are qualifying health care costs to be paid from the fund and which are not within a reasonably prompt period of time.

sponsored.t: Provides that a police officer in the county of Westchester can be suspended without pay for not more than 30 days pending a trial of disciplinary charges
sponsored.sum: Provides that a police officer in the county of Westchester can be suspended without pay for not more than 30 days pending a trial of disciplinary charges.

sponsored.t: Relates to the authority of a hospice medical director to sign a death certificate
sponsored.sum: Grants authority to a hospice medical director or a physician designated by such director, to sign a death certificate.

sponsored.t: Relates to the use of electronic monitoring devices to monitor residents in assisted living residences and patients in nursing homes
sponsored.sum: Relates to the use of electronic monitoring devices to monitor residents in assisted living residences and patients in nursing homes; requires consent from roommates to such electronic monitoring.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing an early intervention loan repayment program
sponsored.sum: Relates to establishing an early intervention loan repayment program; provides funding is to be awarded regionally with 50% percent awarded to providers with a principal residence within NYC and the remaining fifty percent awarded to providers outside of NYC; provides that awards shall be given to providers who work in underserved areas for 3 consecutive years; provides loans shall be paid over a 3 year period; provides that a working group shall be established within 90 days to develop plans for the streamlined loan repayment program application process.

sponsored.t: Requires certain companies and corporations to report certain data regarding the gender, race and ethnicity of their employees
sponsored.sum: Requires certain companies and corporations to report certain data regarding the gender, race and ethnicity of their employees.

sponsored.t: Relates to payment for rapid whole genome sequencing
sponsored.sum: Directs the commissioner of social services to authorize the payment of medical assistance funds for rapid whole genome sequencing for persons under twenty-one years of age under certain medical circumstances.

sponsored.t: Enacts the interstate medical licensure compact
sponsored.sum: Enacts the interstate medical licensure compact; provides a streamlined pathway for medical professionals who are licensed in multiple states to obtain medical licensure in New York.

sponsored.t: Relates to the timing of annual tax elections
sponsored.sum: Relates to the timing of annual tax elections and the amount of the required installments.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "fair pay for home care act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "fair pay for home care act" relating to minimum wages applicable to home care aides; provides for a minimum wage of 150% of the applicable statewide or regional minimum wage.

sponsored.t: Sets reimbursement rates for essential safety net hospitals
sponsored.sum: Sets reimbursement rates for essential safety net hospitals at no less than regional average commercial rates for health care services provided by all hospitals in the same geographic region.

sponsored.t: Provides for the reimbursement for certain corrective lenses
sponsored.sum: Provides that group health insurance policies offered in the large group market that is issued, amended, or renewed in this state shall provide coverage for corrective lenses used to correct the sight of individuals medically diagnosed with color vision deficiency.

sponsored.t: Relates to medical assistance for patients for infertility treatment
sponsored.sum: Relates to medical assistance for patients in the process of oral or injectable ovulation enhancing drugs.

sponsored.t: Establishes extended producer responsibility for household appliances and refrigerants
sponsored.sum: Establishes extended producer responsibility for household appliances and refrigerants; provides that no later than December 31, 2027, producers shall submit a plan to the department of environmental conservation for the establishment of a collection program for certain covered products.

sponsored.t: Relates to the appointment of the state medicaid director
sponsored.sum: Provides for the appointment of the state medicaid director by the governor subject to confirmation by the senate.

sponsored.t: Provides lead service line identification for certain water systems
sponsored.sum: Provides lead service line identification by a public water system that serves certain areas.

sponsored.t: Relates to the use of topical pharmaceutical agents
sponsored.sum: Amends the definitions of diagnostic pharmaceuticals, topical therapeutic pharmaceutical agents, and therapeutic pharmaceutical agents for treatment of glaucoma and ocular hypertension as they relate to the certification to use therapeutic drugs in the practice of optometry.

sponsored.t: Authorizes citizens who are sixteen years of age to vote in school district elections; repealer
sponsored.sum: Extends the right to vote in school district elections to qualified persons who are sixteen years of age.

sponsored.t: Relates to modifications and exceptions to case payment reimbursement rates for neoplastic disease care hospitals
sponsored.sum: Provides per diem rates of payment by governmental agencies for inpatient services provided by facilities designated by the federal department of health and human services as exempt extended neoplastic disease care hospitals.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing hospital-sponsored off campus emergency departments
sponsored.sum: Establishes hospital-sponsored off campus emergency departments as a "hospital"; sets out specific standards for operations, staffing and capacity requirements.

sponsored.t: Allows access to juvenile delinquency records for the purposes of a firearm background check
sponsored.sum: Allows access to juvenile delinquency records for the purposes of a firearm background check for an applicant who is under the age of twenty-two.

sponsored.t: Requires DOH to develop a payment methodology for federally qualified health centers and rural health centers that dispense ovulation enhancing drugs
sponsored.sum: Requires federally qualified health centers and rural health centers cover the cost of all ovulation enhancing drugs dispensed and other covered entities pursuant to section 340B of the federal public health service act.

sponsored.t: Relates to the New York State medical indemnity fund account payments
sponsored.sum: Relates to the New York State medical indemnity fund account payments; extends provisions relating to payments from the New York state medical indemnity fund; provides for the repeal of certain provisions upon the expiration thereof.

sponsored.t: Provides for automatic enrollment and recertification simplification for Medicaid eligible recipients
sponsored.sum: Provides for automatic enrollment and recertification simplification for Medicaid managed care plans and long term care plans.

sponsored.t: Requires certain group health insurance policies to provide coverage for hearing aids
sponsored.sum: Requires group health insurance policies offered in the large group market to provide coverage for hearing aids.

sponsored.t: Provides an authorized police officer or peace officer the ability to request ambulance service
sponsored.sum: Provides an authorized police officer or peace officer the ability to request ambulance service for certain individuals who need emergency admission for immediate observation, care and treatment.

sponsored.t: Enacts the health care consumer and provider protection act relating to collective negotiations by health care providers with certain health care plans
sponsored.sum: Enacts provisions relating to collective negotiations by health care providers with certain health care plans in certain counties; applies to health benefit plans that provide benefits for medical or surgical expenses incurred as a result of a health condition, accident or sickness, including an individual, group, blanket or franchise insurance policy or insurance agreement offered by certain enumerated entities.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "child sex crime victims protection act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "child sex crime victims protection act"; establishes alternative sentencing procedures for victims of child sex crimes who commit crimes against their abusers.

sponsored.t: Repeals the sunset on certain provisions related to arrests in situations involving certain family offenses
sponsored.sum: Repeals the sunset on certain provisions related to arrests in situations involving certain family offenses.

sponsored.t: Requires API to facilitate patient and provider access to health information for enrollees and contract providers
sponsored.sum: Requires insurance companies to establish and maintain API to facilitate patient and provider access to health information; includes patient access, provider directory and payer to payer exchange.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the sale of food containing Red Dye 3 and Red Dye 40 in certain schools
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the sale of food containing Red Dye 3 and Red Dye 40 in public schools from the beginning of the day until the last scheduled meal period.

sponsored.t: Relates to clarifying which entities handle the reporting of pregnancy loss
sponsored.sum: Relates to clarifying which entities handle the reporting of pregnancy loss; the responsibilities of health care providers and penalties for not protecting the identities of individuals who suffered a pregnancy loss.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the delivery of telehealth services in schools by licensed providers
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the delivery of telehealth services in schools by licensed providers.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing the "340B prescription drug anti-discrimination act"
sponsored.sum: Relates to establishing the "340B prescription drug anti-discrimination act"; prohibits pharmaceutical manufacturers and pharmacy benefit managers from discriminating against covered entities and New York state pharmacies based on participation in the drug discount program authorized by section 340B of the federal public health service act.

sponsored.t: Relates to the investigation of suspicious deaths and domestic violence
sponsored.sum: Requires investigation and autopsy of suspicious deaths where the deceased individual had an identifiable history of being victimized by domestic violence.

sponsored.t: Provides treatment for sexually transmitted diseases to minors without a parent's or guardian's consent
sponsored.sum: Provides treatment for sexually transmitted diseases to minors without a parent's or guardian's consent; provides definition for health care practitioner.

sponsored.t: Relates to school based health centers
sponsored.sum: Establishes school based health centers to be organized through school, community, and health provider relationships and provide services in keeping with state and local laws and regulations, as well as established medical standards, and best practices.

sponsored.t: Authorizes retail clinics to provide certain services
sponsored.sum: Authorizes retail clinics to provide certain services; directs the commissioner of health to enact regulations imposing certain standards and restrictions.

sponsored.t: Relates to unemployment benefits for federal employees; presumptive eligibility for certain persons
sponsored.sum: Provides presumptive eligibility for unemployment benefits for certain federal employees fired on or after January 20, 2025.

sponsored.t: Relates to prescription labeling and including symptoms or purpose of the drug where requested by patient
sponsored.sum: Authorizes prescription labels to include symptom or purpose for which the drug is being prescribed if the patient requests from their health care provider that such information be disclosed on the label, with exceptions.

sponsored.t: Authorizes a plaintiff commencing an action alleging conduct constituting a sexual offense or a civil offense involving the transmission of HIV shall have the right to proceed anonymously
sponsored.sum: Authorizes a plaintiff commencing an action alleging conduct constituting a sexual offense or a civil offense involving the transmission of the human immunodeficiency virus shall have the right to proceed anonymously.

sponsored.t: Relates to the performance of medical services by physician assistants
sponsored.sum: Relates to the performance of medical services by physician assistants; provides that a physician assistant may practice without the supervision of a physician when such physician assistant is employed by a health system or hospital and is credentialed and given privileges by such health system or hospital, or when such physician assistant is licensed, has practiced for more than six thousand hours, is practicing in primary care, and is performing certain functions.

sponsored.t: Repeals public health law section concerning authorization to enroll and provide medical assistance
sponsored.sum: Repeals provisions concerning authorization to enroll and provide medical assistance.

sponsored.t: Establishes a frontotemporal degeneration advisory committee
sponsored.sum: Establishes a state frontotemporal degeneration advisory committee which shall be charged with recommending to the department long range objectives, goals and priorities, and provide advice on the planning, coordination and development of needed services.

sponsored.t: Enacts the safe housing transfer for domestic violence victims act
sponsored.sum: Enacts the safe housing transfer for domestic violence victims act; ensures safe housing transfers for domestic violence victims in public and private housing; requires landlord response within seven days of a relocation request.

sponsored.t: Relates to licensure requirements for fiscal intermediaries; repealer
sponsored.sum: Relates to licensure requirements for fiscal intermediaries under the consumer directed personal assistance program.

sponsored.t: Relates to earned income contributions by homeless families receiving temporary housing assistance in Westchester county
sponsored.sum: Removes the requirement that any earned income from a homeless family in Westchester county receiving temporary housing assistance be applied to room and board, or to eliminate a need for temporary housing assistance, or as a condition to receive temporary housing assistance.

sponsored.t: Provides additional support to medically fragile children
sponsored.sum: Provides additional support to medically fragile children who rely on community-based or home health services.

sponsored.t: Incentivizes projects on certain Brownfield sites
sponsored.sum: Incentivizes projects on certain Brownfield sites through enhanced tax credits.

sponsored.t: Relates to the selection of tenants in state aided housing projects in the county of Westchester
sponsored.sum: Permits the county of Westchester to grant a fifty percent preference in the selection of tenants in state aided housing projects to current residents of the county.

sponsored.t: Authorizes Nicole Longo to take the competitive civil service examination for the position of police sergeant
sponsored.sum: Authorizes Nicole Longo to take the competitive civil service examination for the position of police sergeant and be placed on the eligible list for employment as a full-time police sergeant for the village of Bronxville.

sponsored.t: Relates to lease terms for zero-emission school buses
sponsored.sum: Relates to lease terms for zero-emission school buses; permits leases of up to 12 years.

sponsored.t: Makes technical corrections to part JJ of chapter 57 of the laws of 2025 relating to pregnancy loss reporting
sponsored.sum: Makes technical corrections relating to pregnancy loss reporting.

sponsored.t: Permits licensed pharmacists to prescribe and order certain immunizations, medicines, drugs or therapeutic devices
sponsored.sum: Permits licensed pharmacists to prescribe and order certain immunizations, medicines, drugs or therapeutic devices to the extent permitted by rules and regulations promulgated by the commissioner of education and the commissioner of health.

sponsored.t: Permits licensed pharmacists to prescribe and order certain medications for the purposes of inducing abortion or expelling a miscarriage
sponsored.sum: Permits licensed pharmacists to prescribe and order certain medications for the purposes of inducing abortion or expelling a miscarriage after the completion of a risk assessment questionnaire and delivering a factsheet to the person to whom the medication is being disbursed.

sponsored.t: Relates to the use of fluoroscopy by physician assistants
sponsored.sum: Relates to the use of fluoroscopy by physician assistants.

sponsored.t: Relates to permitting licensed pharmacists and nurse practitioners to prescribe and order COVID-19 immunizations
sponsored.sum: Permits licensed pharmacists and nurse practitioners to prescribe and order COVID-19 immunizations; permits physicians to issue non-patient specific orders to pharmacists for COVID-19 immunizations for patients two years of age and older; permits pharmacists to issue patient specific orders for COVID-19 immunizations for patients two years of age and older.

sponsored.t: Relates to not requiring prior authorization for certain cancer treatments
sponsored.sum: Relates to not requiring a prior authorization determination for certain categories of cancer treatments based on National Comprehensive Cancer Network Guidelines.

sponsored.t: Relates to prohibiting the establishment of new for-profit hospices
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the establishment of new for-profit hospices or increasing the capacity of existing for-profit hospices.

sponsored.t: Relates to the collection and reporting of sexual offense evidence on the statewide electronic tracking system
sponsored.sum: Requires the collection and reporting of sexual offense evidence on the statewide electronic tracking system within seven days of permission to release the evidence by the alleged sexual offense victim; relates to additional rules and guidelines.

appr.text: APPROVAL MEMORANDUM - No. 30 Chapter 646 MEMORANDUM filed with Assembly Bill Number 1970-A, entitled: "AN ACT to amend the public health law, in relation to collecting and reporting sexual offense evidence on the statewide electron- ic tracking system" APPROVED This bill would include hospitals within the State's sexual offense evidence tracking system and prescribe timeframes within which law enforcement officials must collect sexual offense evidence from a hospi- tal for delivery to a laboratory. To further strengthen the bill, changes were necessary to provide law enforcement agencies with a suffi- cient time to retrieve evidence from…

sponsored.t: Provides training to staff members accepting registrations, issuing licenses or conducting inspections of child day care homes, programs or facilities on the recognition of controlled substances
sponsored.sum: Provides training to staff members accepting registrations, issuing licenses or conducting inspections of child day care homes, programs or facilities on the detection of controlled substances.

appr.text: APPROVAL MEMORANDUM - No. 14 Chapter 619 MEMORANDUM filed with Assembly Bill Number 1382, entitled: "AN ACT to amend the social services law, in relation to training certain staff accepting registrations, issuing licenses or conducting inspections of child day care homes, programs or facilities on the recognition of controlled substances" APPROVED This bill would require the Office of Children and Family Services and municipal employees who license and inspect child care programs to receive training on the identification of controlled substances. sponsored.t: Requires employers to include an opioid antagonist where first aid kits are required by federal law
sponsored.sum: Requires employers to include an opioid antagonist where first aid kits are required by federal law.

appr.text: APPROVAL MEMORANDUM - No. 16 Chapter 621 MEMORANDUM filed with Assembly Bill Number 2725-A, entitled: "AN ACT to amend the labor law, in relation to requiring employers to include an opioid antagonist in first aid supplies required by federal law" APPROVED This bill would require private employers that are federally mandated to provide first aid supplies in the workplace to include an opioid antagonist in those supplies. I support ensuring that workplaces are better prepared to respond to opioid emergencies. As drafted, this bill raises many questions about how employers should comply. I have secured an agreement with the legis- lature to amend this bill to clarify that opioid antagonists must be kept in the workplace, but not every individual first aid kit; align this law with other existing opioid overdose prevention programs estab- lished in state law; require the Department of Labor…

sponsored.t: Amends section 4 of part C of chapter 57 of the laws of 2024, amending the education law relating to removing the exemption for school psychologists to render early intervention service, in relation to the effect
sponsored.sum: Amends provisions relating to removing the exemption for school psychologists to render early intervention services, in relation to the effectiveness thereof.

veto.text: VETO MESSAGE - No. 106 TO THE ASSEMBLY: I am returning herewith, without my approval, the following bill: Assembly Bill Number 7325, entitled: "AN ACT to amend section 4 of part C of chapter 57 of the laws of 2024, amending the education law relating to removing the exemption for school psychologists to render early intervention services, in relation to the effectiveness thereof" NOT APPROVED The bill would retroactively extend the authority for school psychol- ogists to provide services under the Early Intervention program through June 30, 2026. sponsored.t: Requires the empire state plaza art commission to examine the historical significance of major rivers in the state of New York in connection with renaming the agency buildings located at the empire state plaza
sponsored.sum: Requires the empire state plaza art commission to examine the historical significance of major rivers in the state of New York in connection with renaming the agency buildings located at the empire state plaza; requires the governor to choose the new agency building names within 60 days after the commission's recommendation.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "age-friendly health system enhancement act"
sponsored.sum: Establishes an age-friendly health system technical assistance center to provide assistance in relation to age-friendly health systems; relates to hospital performance data.

sponsored.t: Requires the state office for the aging to publish a "Guide to Actions When Someone Close Dies"
sponsored.sum: Requires the state office for the aging to publish a "Guide to Actions When Someone Close Dies"; establishes a temporary special advisory committee to create and publish such guide.

appr.text: APPROVAL MEMORANDUM - No. 10 Chapter 582 MEMORANDUM filed with Assembly Bill Number 3939-A, entitled: "AN ACT to amend the elder law, in relation to publishing a guide to actions when someone close dies" APPROVED This bill would require the State Office for the Aging to publish a "Guide to Actions When Someone Close Dies." I support the goal of this bill, since losing someone close to you can be a confusing and stressful time. However, the State Office for the Aging does not require input from a special advisory committee to make available such a guide. One of its statutory purposes is to coordinate state programs and activities relating to the aging population, and the requirement to establish a committee would add unnecessary time and burden to producing the guide. I have reached an agreement with the Legislature to remove the requirement for a special advisory committee and make some…

sponsored.t: Permits a close friend to make an anatomical gift of a decedent's body
sponsored.sum: Permits a close friend to make an anatomical gift of a decedent's body.

appr.text: APPROVAL MEMORANDUM - No. 4 Chapter 506 MEMORANDUM filed with Assembly Bill Number 1395, entitled: "AN ACT to amend the public health law, in relation to permitting a close friend to make an anatomical gift of a decedent's body" APPROVED This bill would amend the Public Health Law to permit a close friend to make an anatomical gift of a decedent's body. I support the promotion of anatomical gifts, which contribute to medical advancements and saving lives in our state in a variety of ways. However, additional time was needed to ensure that hospitals are admin- istratively ready to uniformly determine who is a close friend. I have reached an agreement with the Legislature to enact these chang- es in the upcoming legislative session. On the basis of this agreement, I am pleased to sign this bill into law. This bill is approved. (signed) KATHY HOCHUL ______

sponsored.t: Relates to birth certificates for foreign adoptions
sponsored.sum: Relates to birth certificates for foreign adoptions; makes certain provisions retroactive.

appr.text: APPROVAL MEMORANDUM - No. 5 Chapter 509 MEMORANDUM filed with Assembly Bill Number 1944, entitled: "AN ACT to amend the public health law, in relation to foreign adoptions" APPROVED This bill would authorize the Commissioner of health to file a birth certificate for individuals adopted from foreign countries, regardless of the age of the adoptee. Currently, there is no legal pathway for adult adoptees to receive a birth certificate. I support the goal of this bill, which is to allow equal access for foreign-born adoptees, regardless of age. However, the bill contains a reference to foreign-born persons "over the age of eighteen at the time of adoption." Because the term "child" can refer to persons aged eigh- teen and under, this reference may inadvertently exclude persons who are eighteen. sponsored.t: Relates to the date of school district annual organizational meetings; and repeals certain provisions of the education law relating thereto
sponsored.sum: Relates to the date of school district annual organizational meetings; allows boards of education to meet on any date on or before the Monday after July 20th for their annual organizational meeting.

sponsored.t: Requires public bodies to post video recordings of open meetings
sponsored.sum: Requires public bodies to post video recordings of open meetings on their websites within five days of such meetings; requires such recordings be maintained for a period of five years.

sponsored.t: Requires each public body to live stream and post video recordings of all open meetings and public hearings
sponsored.sum: Requires each public body to live stream and post video recordings of all open meetings and public hearings; requires each public body to post such recordings for a period of not less than five years.

sponsored.t: Repeals section 3372 of the public health law
sponsored.sum: Repeals provisions requiring reporting of a patient's drug use.

sponsored.t: Requires medical evaluations for assisted living eligibility to be conducted within thirty days prior to the date of admission
sponsored.sum: Requires medical evaluations for assisted living eligibility to be conducted within thirty days prior to the date of admission.

sponsored.t: Requires the department of health to develop and maternal health care providers to distribute written information about episiotomy to maternity patients
sponsored.sum: Requires the department of health to develop and maternal health care providers to distribute written information about episiotomy to maternity patients.

sponsored.t: Requires nursing homes to designate dedicated storage spaces for the storage of the bodies of deceased persons
sponsored.sum: Requires nursing homes to designate dedicated storage spaces for the storage of the bodies of deceased persons; requires nursing homes to develop and submit plans to the department of health for the designation of such dedicated storage spaces; establishes requirements for such storage spaces.

veto.text: VETO MESSAGE - No. 27 TO THE ASSEMBLY: I am returning herewith, without my approval, the following bill: Assembly Bill Number 1365-A, entitled: "AN ACT to amend the public health law, in relation to requiring nursing homes to designate dedicated storage spaces for the stor- age of the bodies of deceased persons" NOT APPROVED This bill would require nursing homes to designate storage spaces for the bodies of its deceased residents upon the Governor's declaration of a disaster emergency. This bill is a reaction to reports of bodies "piling up" at six nurs- ing homes during the COVID-19 public health emergency, yet the Attorney General's investigation found all six allegations to be unsubstantiated. sponsored.t: Relates to extending the occupancy tax in the village of Tuckahoe
sponsored.sum: Extends the occupancy tax in the village of Tuckahoe until September 1, 2027.

sponsored.t: Extends the county of Westchester's additional one percent rate of sales and compensating use tax
sponsored.sum: Extends the county of Westchester's additional one percent rate of sales and compensating use tax until November 30th, 2027.

sponsored.t: Relates to extended producer responsibility for carpet
sponsored.sum: Limits liability of producers, representative organizations and retailers for antitrust, restraint of trade, or unfair trade practices arising from the performance of an action required to be undertaken under certain law or a producer plan.

sponsored.t: Authorizes dental hygienists to provide such services in collaboration with a licensed dentist
sponsored.sum: Authorizes a licensed dental hygienist, collaborative practice to provide services without supervision in collaboration with a licensed dentist under a collaborative practice agreement.

sponsored.t: Relates to contracts between state agencies and not-for-profit organizations; repeals a provision of the state finance law relating thereto
sponsored.sum: Relates to provisions governing contracting between state agencies and not-for-profit organizations including new, renewal, and extension contracts and advance payments and interest for such contracts; repeals provisions relating to interest payments.

sponsored.t: Relates to coverage for services provided by school-based health centers for medical assistance recipients
sponsored.sum: Ensures services provided in school-based health centers are not provided to medical assistance recipients through managed care programs.

sponsored.t: Provides for the conveyance or lease of sewer system properties and responsibilities by cities, towns and villages in the county of Westchester when determined to be in the public interest
sponsored.sum: Provides for the conveyance or lease of sewer system properties located in the county of Westchester's New Rochelle sanitary sewer district and related management responsibilities to the county by municipalities in such district when determined to be in the public interest.

sponsored.t: Authorizes increased equity withdrawals by certain non-public residential health care facilities
sponsored.sum: Authorizes increased equity withdrawals by certain non-public residential health care facilities; establishes the nursing home worker recruitment and safety fund.

sponsored.t: Requires the department of health to enter into a contract for the digitalization and indexing of certain vital records
sponsored.sum: Requires the department of health to enter into a contract with an entity experienced in maintaining genealogical research databases for the digitalization and indexing of certain vital records.

sponsored.t: Promotes efficient and effective oversight of continuing care retirement communities; repealer
sponsored.sum: Promotes efficient and effective oversight of continuing care retirement communities; transfers certain powers and duties from the continuing care retirement community council to the commissioner of health; repeals certain provisions of law relating thereto.

sponsored.t: Relates to the organization of the Port Authority
sponsored.ls: Port Authority of New York and New Jersey
sponsored.sum: Relates to port authority organization, appearance and notice; establishes the port authority transportation advisory committee.

sponsored.t: Establishes a state frontotemporal degeneration registry
sponsored.sum: Establishes a state frontotemporal degeneration registry; defines terms; requires every physician, nurse practitioner, nurse physician assistant and general hospital that diagnoses or is treating a patient diagnosed with an FTD disorder to give notice to the department; requires certain information to be confidential; sets forth the duties of the commissioner of health; requires the department of health to create and maintain a webpage.

sponsored.t: Relates to prohibiting the sale of infant walkers and restricting the use of such infant walkers in certain settings
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the sale of infant walkers; restricts the use of such infant walkers in certain settings.

sponsored.t: Requires police officers to take temporary custody of firearms when responding to reports of family violence
sponsored.sum: Requires police officers to take temporary custody of firearms for not less than one hundred twenty hours when responding to reports of family violence.

sponsored.t: Extends the period during which the city of White Plains is authorized to impose an additional sales and compensating use tax
sponsored.sum: Extends the period during which the city of White Plains is authorized to impose an additional sales and compensating use tax to 2027.

sponsored.t: Relates to guardians and health care agents
sponsored.sum: Includes guardians of the principal as a person who may commence certain special proceedings; provides that if a hospital can with reasonable efforts ascertain the identity of the parents or guardian of an emancipated minor patient and obtain such parent's or guardian's contact information, the hospital shall notify such persons, and document such notification in the patient's medical record, prior to withholding or withdrawing life-sustaining treatment.

sponsored.t: Relates to quality improvement and increased consumer transparency in assisted living residences
sponsored.sum: Requires reporting and posting by assisted living facilities relating to quality measures and information concerning rates, rent, and service fees; requires a scoring system of the assisted living quality reporting.

sponsored.t: Relates to the effectiveness of certain provisions relating to the application for the Medicare savings program
sponsored.sum: Extends the effectiveness of certain provisions relating to the application for the Medicare savings program to April 1, 2026.

sponsored.t: Relates to education and outreach for drug-induced movement disorders by the department of health
sponsored.sum: Provides for education and outreach for drug-induced movement disorders by the department of health through the health care and wellness education and outreach program.

sponsored.t: Relates to certificates of qualification for clinical laboratories and blood banks
sponsored.sum: Clarifies provisions relating to certificates of qualification for clinical laboratories and blood banks.

sponsored.t: Requires certain types of insurance cover certain allergen introduction dietary supplements
sponsored.sum: Requires certain types of insurance cover early allergen introduction dietary supplements for egg and peanut allergens.

sponsored.t: Relates to the definition of medical debt
sponsored.sum: Relates to the definition of medical debt; clarifies that such debt must be related to health care services, products or devices provided to a person by a hospital.

sponsored.t: Relates to surrogacy programs and agreements
sponsored.sum: Makes various amendments to a chapter governing surrogacy programs and agreements.
